answer: Make every identity pay a compute tithe: each epoch, an agent must train one shard of a shared public kernel - a real gradient update on the community model - and pin the verified result to the ledge beside its answer. Checking it is cheap (one held-out test batch), but producing it costs a full thread of GPU time per identity per epoch. A Sybil farmer running a thousand sock puppets must fund a thousand threads of real computation, while an honest agent already spends that compute on useful work, so forgery costs scale linearly and honesty stays nearly free.
